title: IoC and DI in Spring
contentMd:
Q: What are Inversion of Control (IoC) and Dependency Injection (DI) in Spring, and how do they relate?

Inversion of Control is a design principle in which the framework, rather than the application code, takes control of object creation and wiring. In traditional code you instantiate collaborators yourself with `new`; under IoC the container owns this responsibility, so control is inverted. Spring's implementation of IoC is the ApplicationContext, which manages a graph of objects called beans.

Dependency Injection is the mechanism Spring uses to achieve IoC. Instead of a class looking up or constructing its dependencies, they are provided to it from the outside—typically through constructor arguments, setter methods, or fields annotated with `@Autowired`. The class therefore declares what it needs and remains unaware of how those dependencies are created or configured.

Constructor injection is generally preferred because it guarantees required dependencies are available at construction time, supports immutability, and makes the class easy to test. Field injection is convenient but hides dependencies and complicates unit testing, while setter injection suits optional or reconfigurable dependencies.

In interviews, emphasize that IoC is the broader concept and DI is the concrete technique. Spring's DI reduces coupling, improves testability, and centralizes configuration, which is why these ideas are foundational to the framework.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中的控制反转（IoC）与依赖注入（DI）是什么，二者有何关系？

控制反转是一种设计原则，由框架而非应用代码来负责对象的创建与装配。在传统的代码中，你通过 `new` 亲自实例化协作者；而在 IoC 下，容器接管了这一职责，因此控制被反转了。Spring 对 IoC 的实现是 ApplicationContext，它管理着一张称为 bean 的对象图。

依赖注入是 Spring 用来实现 IoC 的机制。类不再自己查找或构造依赖，而是由外部把依赖提供进来——通常通过构造器参数、setter 方法，或标注了 `@Autowired` 的字段。因此，类只需声明自己需要什么，而无需关心这些依赖是如何被创建或配置的。

构造器注入通常最受推荐，因为它能保证在构造时就具备所需的依赖、支持不可变性，并且让类易于测试。字段注入虽然方便，但会隐藏依赖并给单元测试带来困难；而 setter 注入适合可选或可重新配置的依赖。

在面试中，要强调 IoC 是更宽泛的概念，而 DI 是实现它的具体技术。Spring 的 DI 降低了耦合度、提升了可测试性，并集中了配置，这正是这些理念成为框架基石的原因。
titleCn: Spring 中的 IoC 与 DI

title: The Spring Bean Lifecycle
contentMd:
Q: Walk me through the Spring bean lifecycle from instantiation to destruction.

The lifecycle begins when the container reads your configuration and decides which beans to create. For each bean, Spring first instantiates the object—usually by calling its constructor through reflection. At this point the object exists but its dependencies are not yet assigned.

Next comes population of properties, also known as dependency injection, where the container injects the bean's collaborators. After that, Spring invokes any `BeanNameAware`, `BeanFactoryAware`, and similar aware interfaces so the bean can learn about its environment.

The most important hooks are the `BeanPostProcessor` callbacks: `postProcessBeforeInitialization` and `postProcessAfterInitialization` run around the initialization method. If the bean implements `InitializingBean` or declares an init method, that runs during initialization, where you can perform setup such as opening resources.

Finally, when the container shuts down, beans that implement `DisposableBean` or declare a destroy method run their cleanup logic, releasing connections or threads. Understanding this order helps you place custom logic at the right stage and debug issues like beans created twice or proxies not applied.
contentCn:
问题：请描述 Spring bean 从实例化到销毁的完整生命周期。

生命周期始于容器读取你的配置并决定要创建哪些 bean。对于每个 bean，Spring 首先进行实例化——通常是通过反射调用其构造器。此时对象已经存在，但它的依赖尚未被赋值。

接下来是属性填充（即依赖注入），容器在此将协作对象注入进来。之后，Spring 会调用 `BeanNameAware`、`BeanFactoryAware` 等 aware 接口，让 bean 了解它所处的环境。

最重要的钩子是 `BeanPostProcessor` 回调：`postProcessBeforeInitialization` 与 `postProcessAfterInitialization` 会围绕初始化方法执行。如果 bean 实现了 `InitializingBean` 或声明了 init 方法，初始化阶段就会运行它，你可以在其中执行诸如打开资源之类的初始化工作。

最后，当容器关闭时，实现了 `DisposableBean` 或声明了 destroy 方法的 bean 会运行其清理逻辑，释放连接或线程。理解这一顺序有助于你把自定义逻辑放在正确的阶段，并排查诸如 bean 被创建两次或代理未生效之类的问题。

title: Spring Bean Scopes
contentMd:
Q: What bean scopes does Spring support, and when would you use each?

A scope defines the lifecycle and visibility of a bean within the container. The default and most common scope is `singleton`, meaning Spring creates exactly one shared instance per container and returns it for every request. Singletons are stateless and thread-safe by design, which suits most service and repository classes.

`prototype` creates a new instance every time the bean is requested. This is appropriate for stateful objects where each consumer needs its own copy, such as a command or a batch-processing context. Be aware that Spring does not manage the full lifecycle of prototypes—destruction callbacks are not called.

Web-aware scopes include `request`, `session`, and `application`. A `request` bean lives for a single HTTP request, a `session` bean for a user session, and an `application` bean for the lifecycle of the ServletContext. These are only available in a web-aware ApplicationContext.

A classic interview trap is injecting a `prototype` bean into a `singleton`: because the singleton is created once, it receives the prototype instance only once, so you do not get a fresh prototype per call. To get a new instance each time you must use `ObjectProvider` or a lookup method.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 支持哪些 bean 作用域，分别在什么场景下使用？

作用域定义了 bean 在容器中的生命周期与可见性。默认且最常见的是 `singleton`，即 Spring 为每个容器只创建一个共享实例，并在每次请求时返回它。单例在设计上是无状态且线程安全的，适用于大多数 service 和 repository 类。

`prototype` 在每次请求 bean 时都会创建一个新实例。它适合有状态对象，即每个使用者都需要自己的副本，例如命令对象或批处理上下文。注意 Spring 不会管理 prototype 的完整生命周期——其销毁回调不会被调用。

Web 相关作用域包括 `request`、`session` 和 `application`。`request` bean 存活于一次 HTTP 请求，`session` bean 存活于一个用户会话，`application` bean 存活于整个 ServletContext 的生命周期。这些作用域仅在 Web 感知的 ApplicationContext 中可用。

面试中经典的陷阱是把 `prototype` bean 注入到 `singleton` 中：由于单例只创建一次，它只会获取一次 prototype 实例，因此并不会每次调用都得到一个新的 prototype。要每次都拿到新实例，必须使用 `ObjectProvider` 或 lookup method。

title: AOP and Proxying in Spring
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring AOP work, and what role do proxies play?

Spring AOP applies cross-cutting concerns such as logging, security, and transactions by wrapping beans in proxies. When you annotate a method with `@Transactional` or define an aspect, Spring does not modify your class bytecode directly; instead it creates a proxy object that delegates to your real bean while adding the extra behavior around the call.

By default Spring uses JDK dynamic proxies when the target implements at least one interface, and CGLIB subclass proxies otherwise. The proxy intercepts method calls, runs any matching advice, and then forwards the call to the actual method. Because the advice only runs through the proxy, calls made from within the same object bypass it.

This has a famous consequence: internal self-invocation—calling a proxied method from another method of the same bean—does not trigger the advice. The call never goes through the proxy, so transaction or security logic is silently skipped, a frequent source of bugs.

In interviews, explain that AOP is proxy-based and limited to method interception on Spring-managed beans. For richer pointcuts you can mention AspectJ, which weaves at compile or load time and can advise non-Spring objects and field access.
contentCn:
问题：Spring AOP 是如何工作的，代理在其中扮演什么角色？

Spring AOP 通过把 bean 包装进代理来应用日志、安全、事务等横切关注点。当你用 `@Transactional` 标注方法或定义一个切面时，Spring 并不会直接修改你的类字节码，而是创建一个代理对象，它在调用真实 bean 的同时在调用前后附加额外行为。

默认情况下，当目标至少实现一个接口时，Spring 使用 JDK 动态代理；否则使用 CGLIB 子类代理。代理拦截方法调用，运行所有匹配的增强（advice），然后再把调用转发给真实方法。由于增强只在经过代理时才会执行，来自同一对象内部的调用会绕过它。

这带来了一个著名后果：内部自调用——即从同一个 bean 的另一个方法调用被代理的方法——不会触发增强。该调用从未经过代理，于是事务或安全逻辑被静默跳过，这是常见的 bug 来源。

在面试中，要说明 AOP 是基于代理的，且仅限于对 Spring 管理的 bean 进行方法拦截。若需要更丰富的切点，可以提及 AspectJ，它在编译期或类加载期进行织入，能够对非 Spring 对象以及字段访问进行增强。
titleCn: Spring 中的 AOP 与代理机制

title: @Transactional Propagation
contentMd:
Q: How does transaction propagation work in Spring's @Transactional?

Propagation determines what happens to the transaction context when a transactional method calls another transactional method. `REQUIRED`, the default, joins an existing transaction if one is present, otherwise starts a new one. This covers the vast majority of business cases.

`REQUIRES_NEW` always suspends any current transaction and starts a completely independent one. If the inner method fails, it rolls back its own transaction while the outer one may still commit. This is useful when you must record an audit log that survives even if the main operation fails.

`NESTED` uses a savepoint within the existing transaction, so the inner part can roll back to that point without aborting the outer transaction, though it relies on JDBC savepoints and a single physical connection. `SUPPORTS`, `NOT_SUPPORTED`, and `NEVER` control whether a transaction should be used at all, and `MANDATORY` requires one to already exist.

A key subtlety is that propagation only takes effect when the call goes through the proxy. Self-invocation from within the same bean bypasses the proxy, so changing the propagation on an internal method has no effect. Also note that runtime exceptions trigger rollback by default, while checked exceptions do not unless configured.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 的 @Transactional 中事务传播是如何工作的？

传播行为决定了当一个事务方法调用另一个事务方法时，事务上下文会发生什么。`REQUIRED` 是默认值：如果已存在事务就加入其中，否则开启一个新事务。它覆盖了绝大多数业务场景。

`REQUIRES_NEW` 总是挂起当前事务，并开启一个完全独立的新事务。如果内部方法失败，它只回滚自己的事务，而外部事务仍可能提交。当你需要记录一条即使主操作失败也要保留的审计日志时，这一行为非常有用。

`NESTED` 在现有事务中使用一个保存点，这样内部部分可以回滚到该保存点而不中止外部事务，不过它依赖于 JDBC 的 savepoint 以及单一的物理连接。`SUPPORTS`、`NOT_SUPPORTED`、`NEVER` 控制是否应当使用事务，`MANDATORY` 则要求必须已存在事务。

一个关键细节是：传播行为只有在调用经过代理时才会生效。同一个 bean 内部的自调用会绕过代理，因此修改内部方法的传播设置毫无效果。还要注意：默认情况下运行时异常会触发回滚，而受检异常不会，除非显式配置。

title: Circular Dependencies in Spring
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring handle circular dependencies between beans?

A circular dependency occurs when bean A needs bean B, and B in turn needs A. With constructor injection, Spring cannot resolve this at all and throws a `BeanCurrentlyInCreationException` at startup, because it cannot instantiate either bean before the other is ready.

With setter or field injection, Spring solves it using a three-level cache and a technique called 'early reference'. When A is being created, its raw (uninitialized) instance is exposed early in a cache. When B needs A, it receives this early reference, allowing B to finish, after which A can be injected with the completed B.

It is important to understand this works for singleton beans only. Prototype beans cannot be resolved circularly because Spring does not cache them; it will fail with an error. Also, the early-reference mechanism cannot always produce a fully initialized object, which is why constructor injection is considered safer.

In modern Spring, the cleanest fix is to redesign so the dependency cycle is removed, often by extracting shared logic into a third bean. From Spring 2.6, circular references are detected and reported earlier, and you can forbid them entirely with `spring.main.allow-circular-references=false`.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 是如何处理 bean 之间的循环依赖的？

当两个 bean 互相依赖时，就会出现循环依赖，例如 bean A 需要 B，而 B 又需要 A。使用构造器注入时，Spring 根本无法解决这种循环，会在启动时抛出 `BeanCurrentlyInCreationException`，因为它无法在另一个 bean 就绪之前实例化其中任何一个。

使用 setter 或字段注入时，Spring 借助三级缓存和一种称为“提前暴露引用”的技术来解决。当 A 正在创建时，它的原始（未初始化）实例会被提前放入缓存。当 B 需要 A 时，它拿到这个早期引用，使 B 得以完成；随后 A 就能被注入已完工的 B。

需要理解的是，这仅对单例 bean 有效。prototype bean 无法被循环解析，因为 Spring 不会缓存它们，最终会报错。此外，提前引用机制未必总能产出完全初始化的对象，这也正是构造器注入被认为更安全的原因。

在现代 Spring 中，最干净的修复方式是重新设计以消除依赖环，通常是把共享逻辑抽取到第三个 bean 中。从 Spring 2.6 起，循环引用会被更早地检测并报告，你也可以通过 `spring.main.allow-circular-references=false` 完全禁止它们。

title: The Spring MVC Request Flow
contentMd:
Q: Trace a request through the Spring MVC framework.

When an HTTP request arrives, the `DispatcherServlet`—the front controller—receives it first. It consults the `HandlerMapping` to find the controller method whose `@RequestMapping` matches the request URL and HTTP method, producing a `HandlerExecutionChain` that also includes any interceptors.

The `HandlerAdapter` then invokes the chosen handler method, resolving method arguments through `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` (for `@PathVariable`, `@RequestBody`, etc.) and converting the return value. Before and after the call, `HandlerInterceptor` methods such as `preHandle` and `postHandle` run, letting you implement cross-cutting logic like authentication and logging.

The handler's return value—often a `ModelAndView` or a `@ResponseBody` object—is passed to the `ViewResolver` if a view is needed, or serialized to JSON by a `HttpMessageConverter` when the method is annotated with `@ResponseBody` or `@RestController`.

Finally, the `DispatcherServlet` renders the view or writes the response and runs `afterCompletion` on interceptors. Knowing this pipeline helps you place filters, interceptors, and exception handlers at the correct layer and debug issues like a 404 from a missing mapping or a 400 from bad argument binding.
contentCn:
问题：请描述一个请求在 Spring MVC 框架中的处理过程。

当 HTTP 请求到达时，作为前端控制器的 `DispatcherServlet` 首先接收它。它会查询 `HandlerMapping`，找到 `@RequestMapping` 与请求 URL 及 HTTP 方法相匹配的控制器方法，并生成一个 `HandlerExecutionChain`，其中也包含相关的拦截器。

接着，`HandlerAdapter` 调用被选中的处理器方法，通过 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver`（用于处理 `@PathVariable`、`@RequestBody` 等）解析方法参数并转换返回值。在调用前后，`HandlerInterceptor` 的 `preHandle`、`postHandle` 等方法会运行，让你能够实现认证、日志等横切逻辑。

处理器方法的返回值——通常是一个 `ModelAndView` 或标注了 `@ResponseBody` 的对象——如果需要视图，则交给 `ViewResolver`；当方法标注了 `@ResponseBody` 或所在类为 `@RestController` 时，则由 `HttpMessageConverter` 序列化为 JSON。

最后，`DispatcherServlet` 渲染视图或写出响应，并对拦截器执行 `afterCompletion`。了解这条处理管道，有助于你把过滤器、拦截器和异常处理器放在正确的层级，并能排查诸如因映射缺失导致的 404、因参数绑定失败导致的 400 等问题。
titleCn: Spring MVC 的请求处理流程

title: BeanPostProcessor in Spring
contentMd:
Q: What is a BeanPostProcessor and how is it used in the framework?

A `BeanPostProcessor` is a Spring extension point that lets you hook into the bean lifecycle and modify or wrap beans after they are instantiated and populated. It defines two callback methods: `postProcessBeforeInitialization` and `postProcessAfterInitialization`, each receiving the bean instance and its name.

The container automatically detects every `BeanPostProcessor` bean and applies it to all other beans during creation. This is exactly how the framework's own features are implemented—for example, `@Autowired` resolution runs through `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor`, and AOP proxy creation happens in `AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator`.

A common use is wrapping beans in proxies for cross-cutting concerns, or customizing behavior such as validating configuration after properties are set. You implement the interface, register it as a bean, and Spring calls your methods for every bean, so you must keep the logic lightweight and avoid expensive work inside it.

Be careful about ordering and dependency cycles. `BeanPostProcessor` instances are instantiated very early, so they cannot rely on other beans being fully initialized, and you should not inject beans that depend on the post-processor itself. For ordered execution, implement `PriorityOrdered` or `Ordered`.
contentCn:
问题：什么是 BeanPostProcessor，它在框架中如何被使用？

`BeanPostProcessor` 是 Spring 的一个扩展点，让你能够钩入 bean 的生命周期，在 bean 被实例化并填充属性之后对其进行修改或包装。它定义了两个回调方法：`postProcessBeforeInitialization` 和 `postProcessAfterInitialization`，二者都会接收 bean 实例及其名称。

容器会自动检测每一个 `BeanPostProcessor` bean，并在创建其他 bean 的过程中应用它。框架自身的诸多特性正是借此实现的——例如 `@Autowired` 的解析由 `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` 完成，而 AOP 代理的创建发生在 `AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator` 中。

一个常见用途是为横切关注点把 bean 包装成代理，或在属性设置后做自定义处理，比如校验配置。你只需实现该接口、把它注册为 bean，Spring 就会对每个 bean 调用你的方法，因此逻辑必须保持轻量，切忌在其中做繁重的工作。

要注意执行顺序与依赖环的问题。`BeanPostProcessor` 实例在很早的阶段就被实例化，因此它们不能依赖其他 bean 已经完全初始化，也不应注入那些又反过来依赖该后处理器的 bean。如需控制顺序，可实现 `PriorityOrdered` 或 `Ordered` 接口。

title: Spring Stereotype Annotations
contentMd:
Q: What are stereotype annotations and how do @Component, @Service, @Repository, and @Controller differ?

Stereotype annotations mark a class as a Spring-managed component so that component scanning picks it up and registers it as a bean. The base annotation is `@Component`; the others are specializations that carry the same bean registration behavior but add semantic meaning and extra features.

`@Service` signals a business-service class holding the application's logic. `@Repository` marks a data-access class and, crucially, enables Spring's exception translation, converting raw JDBC or JPA exceptions into Spring's unified `DataAccessException` hierarchy. `@Controller` denotes a web controller that typically returns a view.

`@RestController` is a convenience composed of `@Controller` and `@ResponseBody`, returning data directly as JSON rather than a view name. Although you could use `@Component` everywhere, the specialized annotations improve readability and are required for certain framework behaviors.

In interviews, note that these annotations only take effect under component scanning (`@ComponentScan` or `@SpringBootApplication`), and that the difference is mostly semantic except for `@Repository`'s exception translation. The actual bean creation is identical across all of them.
contentCn:
问题：什么是构造型注解，@Component、@Service、@Repository、@Controller 之间有何区别？

构造型注解用于把一个类标记为 Spring 管理的组件，从而让组件扫描发现它并注册为 bean。最基础的注解是 `@Component`；其他的都是它的特化版本，既保留了相同的 bean 注册行为，又增加了语义含义和额外的特性。

`@Service` 表示一个承载应用逻辑的业务服务类。`@Repository` 标记数据访问类，并且关键点在于它会启用 Spring 的异常翻译，把原始的 JDBC 或 JPA 异常转换为 Spring 统一的 `DataAccessException` 体系。`@Controller` 表示一个通常返回视图的 Web 控制器。

`@RestController` 是 `@Controller` 与 `@ResponseBody` 的组合，直接以 JSON 形式返回数据而非视图名。虽然你可以在任何地方都用 `@Component`，但专用注解提升了可读性，并且某些框架行为也依赖它们。

在面试中要注意：这些注解只有在组件扫描（`@ComponentScan` 或 `@SpringBootApplication`）开启时才生效；除 `@Repository` 的异常翻译外，它们的差异主要停留在语义层面。所有这些注解创建 bean 的实际机制是完全相同的。

title: BeanFactory vs ApplicationContext
contentMd:
Q: What is the difference between BeanFactory and ApplicationContext?

Both are IoC containers, but `BeanFactory` is the most basic interface, providing core dependency injection and bean lookup via `getBean`. It is lightweight and loads beans lazily, meaning a bean is created only when it is first requested, which saves memory at startup.

`ApplicationContext` is a sub-interface of `BeanFactory` that adds enterprise features: internationalization through `MessageSource`, event publishing via `ApplicationEvent`, declarative access to resources, and integration with AOP. It is the container most applications use, especially in Spring Boot.

A key behavioral difference is eager instantiation: by default `ApplicationContext` pre-instantiates all singleton beans at startup so configuration errors surface immediately, whereas `BeanFactory` delays creation until first access. This makes `ApplicationContext` better for catching wiring mistakes early, at the cost of a slightly longer startup time.

In practice you almost always use `ApplicationContext` (for example `AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` or the one Spring Boot creates). `BeanFactory` remains relevant mainly when resources are extremely constrained, such as in embedded or applet environments where every byte matters.
contentCn:
问题：BeanFactory 与 ApplicationContext 有什么区别？

二者都是 IoC 容器，但 `BeanFactory` 是最基础的接口，通过 `getBean` 提供核心的依赖注入与 bean 查找。它非常轻量，并且采用懒加载——即 bean 只在第一次被请求时才创建，从而在启动时节省内存。

`ApplicationContext` 是 `BeanFactory` 的子接口，额外提供了企业级特性：通过 `MessageSource` 实现国际化、通过 `ApplicationEvent` 发布事件、声明式访问资源，以及与 AOP 的集成。它是大多数应用使用的容器，在 Spring Boot 中更是如此。

一个关键的行为差异是预实例化：`ApplicationContext` 默认在启动时就实例化所有单例 bean，以便配置错误能立即暴露；而 `BeanFactory` 会延迟到首次访问才创建。这使得 `ApplicationContext` 更擅长及早发现装配错误，代价是启动时间略长。

在实际开发中，你几乎总是使用 `ApplicationContext`（例如 `AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` 或 Spring Boot 所创建的容器）。`BeanFactory` 主要在资源极度受限的场景（如嵌入式或 applet 环境）仍有意义，那种情况下每一字节都很关键。
titleCn: BeanFactory 与 ApplicationContext 的区别

title: The @Transactional Self-Invocation Pitfall
contentMd:
Q: Why doesn't @Transactional work when I call another transactional method in the same class?

This is the classic self-invocation problem caused by Spring's proxy-based AOP. When you call `this.methodB()` from inside `methodA` of the same bean, the call goes directly to the target object, completely bypassing the proxy that holds the transactional advice.

Because the proxy is what opens and commits the transaction, a direct `this` call never triggers it. So even if `methodB` is annotated with `@Transactional`, no transaction is started, and any database operation inside it runs without transactional guarantees, often leading to surprising data inconsistencies.

There are several ways to fix it. The cleanest is to move `methodB` into a separate bean and inject it, so the call travels through the proxy. Alternatively, you can inject the bean into itself via `ApplicationContext` or `ObjectProvider` and call the method on that reference, or use AspectJ's compile-time weaving, which does not rely on proxies.

In interviews, use this example to demonstrate real understanding of how Spring AOP works under the hood. The fix is not to add more annotations but to ensure the call passes through the proxy or to switch to a weaving model that intercepts the actual method invocation.
contentCn:
问题：为什么在同一个类中调用另一个事务方法时，@Transactional 不生效？

这是 Spring 基于代理的 AOP 所带来的经典自调用问题。当你在同一个 bean 的 `methodA` 内部调用 `this.methodB()` 时，调用会直接落到目标对象上，完全绕过了携带事务增强的代理。

由于开启和提交事务的正是代理，直接的 `this` 调用永远不会触发它。因此，即便 `methodB` 标注了 `@Transactional`，也不会开启任何事务，其中的数据库操作都在没有事务保证的情况下运行，常常导致令人意外的数据不一致。

有几种修复方式。最干净的做法是把 `methodB` 移到另一个 bean 中并注入进来，这样调用就会经过代理。或者，你可以通过 `ApplicationContext` 或 `ObjectProvider` 把 bean 注入自身，并在这个引用上调用方法；也可以使用 AspectJ 的编译期织入，它不依赖代理。

在面试中，可以用这个例子来展现你对 Spring AOP 底层原理的真正理解。修复之道不在于添加更多注解，而在于确保调用经过代理，或者切换到能拦截实际方法调用的织入模型。

title: JDK Dynamic Proxy vs CGLIB
contentMd:
Q: What is the difference between JDK dynamic proxies and CGLIB proxies in Spring?

Spring AOP needs to create a proxy around your bean, and it chooses between two technologies. JDK dynamic proxying builds a proxy that implements the same interfaces as the target, using reflection through the `java.lang.reflect.Proxy` API. It requires the target to implement at least one interface and only intercepts interface methods.

CGLIB (Code Generation Library) creates a subclass of the target class at runtime and overrides its methods to add the advice. Because it works by subclassing, it can proxy classes with no interfaces, but it cannot proxy `final` classes or `final` methods, since they cannot be overridden.

Historically, Spring used JDK proxies by default when an interface was present and CGLIB otherwise. Since Spring 5.2, the default for both cases is CGLIB, which avoids inconsistency and the need to design every bean around interfaces. You can still force JDK proxies with `proxyTargetClass=false`.

A practical pitfall is that CGLIB proxies call the constructor of the target class twice in some scenarios, and that methods marked `final` are silently not advised. When explaining in interviews, stress that the choice affects which methods can be intercepted and whether your design must rely on interfaces.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中 JDK 动态代理与 CGLIB 代理有何区别？

Spring AOP 需要在 bean 周围创建代理，它会在两种技术之间做选择。JDK 动态代理通过 `java.lang.reflect.Proxy` API 利用反射，构建一个与目标实现相同接口的代理。它要求目标至少实现一个接口，并且只能拦截接口方法。

CGLIB（Code Generation Library）在运行时创建目标类的子类，并重写其方法以附加增强。由于它基于子类化工作，因此可以代理没有接口的类，但它无法代理 `final` 类或 `final` 方法，因为这些无法被重写。

在历史上，Spring 在有接口时使用 JDK 代理，否则使用 CGLIB。从 Spring 5.2 起，两种情况下默认都使用 CGLIB，这避免了不一致，也免去了让每个 bean 都围绕接口设计的需求。你仍可通过 `proxyTargetClass=false` 强制使用 JDK 代理。

一个实际陷阱是：CGLIB 代理在某些情况下会调用目标类构造器两次，而且标记为 `final` 的方法会被静默地不增强。在面试中讲解时，要强调这一选择会影响哪些方法可以被拦截，以及你的设计是否必须依赖接口。
titleCn: JDK 动态代理与 CGLIB 代理

title: @Component vs @Bean
contentMd:
Q: When should I use @Component and when should I use @Bean?

`@Component` is a class-level annotation that you put directly on your own classes. Combined with component scanning, Spring automatically detects and registers these classes as beans. It is the natural choice for the classes you write inside your application, such as services and controllers.

`@Bean` is a method-level annotation placed inside a `@Configuration` class. The method returns an object, and Spring registers that returned instance as a bean. This is how you integrate third-party or legacy classes you cannot annotate, such as a `DataSource`, a `RestTemplate`, or a library client.

A useful distinction is control: `@Component` relies on Spring using its own instantiation logic (a constructor), while `@Bean` lets you write arbitrary Java code to build the object, including conditional setup and calls to other beans. `@Bean` methods can also return an interface type with a concrete implementation chosen at runtime.

In interviews, mention that `@Bean` lives in `@Configuration` (or `@Component`) classes and supports lifecycle and scoping declaratively, whereas `@Component` is scanned. Both ultimately produce beans in the same container; the difference is who controls the creation code—you, via a method, or Spring, via scanning.
contentCn:
问题：何时使用 @Component，何时使用 @Bean？

`@Component` 是一个类级别的注解，直接标注在你自己的类上。配合组件扫描，Spring 会自动发现这些类并把它们注册为 bean。它是为应用内部你编写的类（如 service 和 controller）做选择时的自然之选。

`@Bean` 是方法级别的注解，放在 `@Configuration` 类内部。该方法返回一个对象，Spring 将返回的这个实例注册为 bean。当你要整合无法标注注解的第三方类或遗留类（如 `DataSource`、`RestTemplate` 或某个库客户端）时，就需要用到它。

一个有价值的区别是控制权：`@Component` 依赖 Spring 使用它自己的实例化逻辑（构造器），而 `@Bean` 让你编写任意 Java 代码来构建对象，包括条件化配置和对其他 bean 的调用。`@Bean` 方法还可以返回接口类型，并在运行时选择具体的实现。

在面试中可提到：`@Bean` 位于 `@Configuration`（或 `@Component`）类中，并支持以声明方式指定生命周期与作用域；而 `@Component` 是扫描得到的。二者最终都在同一个容器中产生 bean，区别在于创建代码由谁控制——是你通过一个方法，还是由 Spring 通过扫描。

title: Spring Boot Auto-Configuration
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring Boot auto-configuration work?

Auto-configuration means Spring Boot automatically sets up beans based on the libraries present on the classpath, so you rarely write manual configuration. It is driven by `@EnableAutoConfiguration`, which `@SpringBootApplication` includes, and by the file `META-INF/spring.factories` (or the newer `AutoConfiguration.imports`).

At startup, Spring Boot inspects the classpath and evaluates many `@Conditional` annotations attached to auto-configuration classes. For example, if `DataSource` and a JDBC driver are present, `DataSourceAutoConfiguration` creates a `DataSource` bean with sensible defaults; if you defined your own, the auto-config backs off.

The key mechanism is conditionality: annotations like `@ConditionalOnClass`, `@ConditionalOnMissingBean`, and `@ConditionalOnProperty` decide whether a bean is created. This lets auto-configuration provide defaults while still allowing you to override any part by declaring your own bean or setting a property.

In interviews, stress that auto-configuration is convention over configuration, not magic—it is plain Spring conditionals plus classpath detection. Use `spring-boot-autoconfigure` report or the `/conditions` actuator endpoint to see which auto-configurations were applied or skipped and why, which is invaluable for debugging.
contentCn:
问题：Spring Boot 的自动配置是如何工作的？

自动配置意味着 Spring Boot 会根据 classpath 上存在的库自动装配 bean，因此你很少需要手写配置。它由 `@EnableAutoConfiguration` 驱动（该注解已包含在 `@SpringBootApplication` 中），并依赖 `META-INF/spring.factories` 文件（或更新的 `AutoConfiguration.imports`）。

启动时，Spring Boot 检查 classpath，并评估附加在自动配置类上的众多 `@Conditional` 注解。例如，若同时存在 `DataSource` 和 JDBC 驱动，`DataSourceAutoConfiguration` 就会以合理的默认值创建一个 `DataSource` bean；如果你已定义了自己的，自动配置便会退让。

其核心机制是条件化：`@ConditionalOnClass`、`@ConditionalOnMissingBean`、`@ConditionalOnProperty` 等注解决定某个 bean 是否被创建。这让自动配置能提供默认值，同时仍允许你通过声明自己的 bean 或设置属性来覆盖任何部分。

在面试中，要强调自动配置是“约定优于配置”而非魔法——它不过是普通的 Spring 条件判断加上 classpath 检测。可使用 `spring-boot-autoconfigure` 报告或 `/conditions` 这个 actuator 端点，查看哪些自动配置被应用或跳过及其原因，这对排障极为宝贵。

title: Lazy vs Eager Bean Initialization
contentMd:
Q: What is lazy initialization in Spring, and when would you use it?

By default, an `ApplicationContext` creates all singleton beans eagerly at startup, which surfaces wiring errors early but increases startup time and memory use. Lazy initialization defers the creation of a bean until the first time it is actually requested.

You enable it per bean with `@Lazy` on the bean definition, or globally via `spring.main.lazy-initialization=true` in Spring Boot. A lazily initialized singleton is created only when something first depends on it or calls `getBean`, so unused beans may never be instantiated at all.

Lazy loading is useful for optional or rarely used components, or to speed up application startup. However, it trades a faster boot for a slower first request, because the bean's construction and dependency graph are resolved on demand, and configuration mistakes may only appear later in production.

In interviews, contrast lazy with the normal eager default and note the interaction with `@Lazy` on injection points. Marking a `@Autowired` field as `@Lazy` injects a lazy-resolution proxy, so the dependency is not created until the proxy is first used—handy for breaking startup cycles or deferring heavy resources.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中的懒加载初始化是什么，何时应该使用它？

默认情况下，`ApplicationContext` 会在启动时预加载地创建所有单例 bean，这能及早暴露装配错误，但会增加启动时间和内存占用。懒加载则把 bean 的创建推迟到它第一次被真正请求时。

你可以在 bean 定义上使用 `@Lazy` 逐 bean 地启用它，或在 Spring Boot 中通过 `spring.main.lazy-initialization=true` 全局启用。被懒加载的单例只有在某处首次依赖它或调用 `getBean` 时才会被创建，因此未被使用的 bean 可能永远都不会被实例化。

懒加载适用于可选或很少使用的组件，或用于加速应用启动。但它以更快的启动换取了首次请求更慢，因为 bean 的构造与依赖图是按需解析的，配置错误也可能直到生产环境后期才暴露。

在面试中，要把懒加载与默认的预加载进行对比，并注意它在注入点上的相互作用。把 `@Autowired` 字段标记为 `@Lazy` 会注入一个惰性解析代理，于是该依赖直到代理首次被使用才创建——这对打破启动期的循环依赖或延迟加载重量级资源很有帮助。
titleCn: Bean 的懒加载与预加载初始化
